N810 triangle trace (scripts/device/take-trace.sh): what our driver does for one frame, in hex
====================================================================================================
Linux n810 6.18.58 #2 Fri Nov  6 14:17:05 UTC 2026 armv6l GNU/Linux
One job = a 64x64 ARGB8888 target, one Gouraud triangle (mbx/tools/tri_frame.h). The module was freshly loaded
before job 1; job 2 is the next one. The target was filled with 0xff202020 by the CPU before each job.
